targets.rawSql: SELECT completed_at AS time, model_call_id, logical_purpose, outcome, requested_model, requested_service_tier, input_tokens, cached_input_tokens, cache_write_tokens, output_tokens, reasoning_tokens, estimated_cost_usd, analysis_trace_id FROM model_call_summaries ORDER BY completed_at DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(estimated_cost_usd),0) AS value FROM model_call_summaries WHERE completed_at > now() - interval '24 hours'

targets.expr: sum by (purpose, outcome) (rate(pypi_reasoning_model_duration_seconds_sum[5m])) / sum by (purpose, outcome) (rate(pypi_reasoning_model_duration_seconds_count[5m]))

panels.title: Model capture status for selected trace
panels.description: Model payload content remains restricted to the application role. This view reports whether local capture occurred alongside bounded usage and cost metadata.

targets.rawSql: SELECT completed_at AS time, logical_purpose, physical_attempt, requested_model, outcome, capture_status, input_tokens, cached_input_tokens, cache_write_tokens, output_tokens, reasoning_tokens, estimated_cost_usd FROM model_call_summaries WHERE (${trace_id:sqlstring} = '' OR analysis_trace_id = ${trace_id:sqlstring}) ORDER BY completed_at
